text: Figure 7.4: TriggerInterface communication path In general case the structured data is passed to DDS middleware that performs its own processing, serializes resulting data into an RTPS packet and then saves the final RTPS packet into the lower PDU ( DdsRtpsDataTxPdu or DdsRtpsMulticas- tDataTxPdu). This PDU is forwarded to the PduR and then to the transport layer (e.g SoAd). Thereby the DDS middleware internal policies decide which target PDU is used. Dds interacts with the PduR only offering a PDU-based interface for the incoming and outgoing PDUs. The transport layer provides a set of connections suitable to enable the DDS communication. Connections can be even automatically configured by the Dds Dynamic discovery engine.
